description: Shows one Rare or Epic card that is in a pack pool right now: name, insured value, picture, and every pack it can come from with that pack's price and the chance per pack of pulling this exact card. Use it after search_cards, passing the nft field of a result; use search_cards when you only have a card name. Read-only; fails with a clear message if the card has just been pulled and left the pool.

nft.description: The card's NFT address (Solana, base58) from a search_cards result, e.g. 7xKX...q9Fz.

name: get_card
title: One card in detail
